## About
Lewis and Sons is a family-owned and operated heating and air conditioning company in Mesa. My father, Bud Lewis, Sr., and I started the business together, and working with him was an awesome experience.
Today my brother, Bud Lewis, Jr., and I carry on the family tradition of running the business. We hope that someday our sons will do the same.
We handle sales, service, repair and installation of heating and cooling equipment for homes and businesses in Mesa, Phoenix, Tempe, Chandler, Scottsdale and Gilbert. We're licensed, bonded and insured, and we're rated 4.8 on Google from 77 reviews.

## Services
- Sales and installation: New heating and cooling equipment, sold and installed by our family.
- AC repair: We find what's wrong with your air conditioner and fix it. One reviewer who knows home systems said she trusted the repair Jeff did.
- New A/C unit: When your old unit can't keep up, we'll give you honest information and a fair quote on a new A/C unit.
- Mini split: One customer had Jeff and Bud put a mini split in his garage workshop and called it a game changer.

## FAQ
Q: What areas do you serve?
A: We work across the metro Phoenix area, including Phoenix, Mesa, Tempe, Chandler, Scottsdale and Gilbert.

Q: Do you work on commercial systems or just homes?
A: Both. We handle sales, service, repair and installation for commercial and residential heating and cooling equipment.

Q: Is it worth keeping my older air conditioner?
A: Air conditioners older than 12-15 years may not be very efficient. If you want to keep an older unit going, it needs proper operation and maintenance.

Q: My AC is low on refrigerant. Can you just top it off?
A: If it's leaking, adding refrigerant won't solve it. The leak should be fixed and tested, then the system charged with the correct amount.

Q: Is the work covered by a warranty?
A: One reviewer wrote that we warranty our service and the unit. Ask us about the details for your job.
